slices.title: Universal trust, permissions and approval broker

acceptance.text: Five risk classes; 'unknown' carries the external_write policy floor and can never auto-allow.
Receipt binds user, session, connector+version, tool, normalized args hash, preview, risk, provenance, policy digest, expiry, scope.
Any argument or policy change between approval and execution supersedes the receipt.
Allowed receipts are consumed atomically; a second presenter loses.
Every production connector dispatch passes the broker; enforced by scripts/check-approval-dispatch.mjs at AST level.
Anthropic native mcp_servers path removed; forbidden by name in the static gate.
Callers with no person attached refuse immediately instead of waiting out the TTL.
always_ask / ask_for_any_change / ask_for_important_actions / allow_selected_low_risk / block, plus lockdown and per-connector blocklist.
GET /api/approvals and POST /api/approvals/[id], digest-bound, typed refusal codes.
Approval card shows exact redacted arguments, untrusted provenance, live expiry; scope-allow only where permitted.
Permissions settings section for policy, lockdown and blocked connectors.

Native chat decodes non-terminal approval SSE frames, recovers pending/recent receipts from /api/approvals, renders a shared macOS/iOS NativeChatApprovalCard with exact redacted detail and expiry, and verifies receiptDigest on decisions; covered by NativeChatAPIClientTests.testChatApprovalStreamRecoveryAndDigestBoundDecision plus both app builds.
Skill/plugin manifests are scanned with stored evidence, fail-closed unknown/blocked states, and permission-expansion consent; covered by work skill-security tests and contract checks.
Skill egress grants are enforced with default-deny, and design previews use per-frame CSP plus sandboxing; the global application CSP remains report-only by design.

slices.title: One cost ledger and one hard ceiling across every spending path

acceptance.text: The personal/OWNER account has a hard monthly ceiling defaulting to EUR 15, configurable downward, raised only by explicit user action. The effective-budget resolver supplies the default when OWNER has no plan figure; covered by tests/spend-ceiling.test.ts.
Work runs call recordWorkRunSpend at park and finish boundaries, with cumulative-to-delta idempotency. Runtime/database coverage is gated on WORK_TEST_DATABASE_URL.
Voice sessions report monotonic, idempotent spend during the relay session and the route re-checks the shared ceiling; covered by tests/voice-spend-report.test.ts.
Deep research records planner/model spend and vendor search/extract fees to both the run odometer and ApiSpend.
Provider SDK adapters set maxRetries: 0; higher-level retry/accounting paths remain explicit and are covered by adapter and spend tests.
Concurrent work uses a conditional SpendPeriod reservation and settles/releases it atomically; covered by tests/spend-ceiling.test.ts.

Research and unattended Work have explicit unit ceilings; voice enforces a global one-hour session ceiling (or the lower provider cap) across provider switches and the shared monthly ceiling; covered by relay/tests/security.test.ts.
Unusually expensive Work is estimated before admission and requires explicit confirmation; covered by tests/work-preflight.test.ts and route wiring.

slices.title: Provider-independent knowledge engine and structured document ingestion

acceptance.text: Provider-independent PDF extraction writes citable page blocks and explicit degraded results for unreadable/scanned material; covered by tests/knowledge-extract.test.ts.
DOCX, PPTX, XLSX and text/CSV extraction preserve headings, slides, sheets, cells and line ranges; covered by tests/knowledge-extract.test.ts.
OCR is a bounded fallback only, with engine/version, confidence and optional bounding boxes; embedded text and OCR remain distinguishable. Covered by tests/knowledge-ocr.test.ts.
KnowledgeDocument, Block, Chunk and IndexJob are persisted with user/project ownership and version chains; OCR provenance is retained in extraction metadata.
Hybrid lexical + optional embedding retrieval, metadata filters, RRF/reranking and bounded context packing are covered by tests/knowledge-retrieve.test.ts.
Retrieved blocks carry page/slide/sheet/cell/path locators into chat context, unified search destinations and the document inspector.
Queued/extracting/indexing/ready/degraded/failed/stale states are durable and exposed by /api/knowledge/documents; OCR is still not a separate worker state.
Project indexing UI now reflects the durable server state instead of a timed cosmetic progress bar.

Direct conversation attachments retrieve owner-scoped indexed passages independently of project membership, and pending/unavailable parser states are explicit to every provider adapter; covered by tests/chat-context-assembly.test.ts, tests/knowledge-retrieve.test.ts and tests/attachment-context.test.ts.

Unreadable/scanned PDFs produce an explicit degraded result and are not silently dropped or represented as a filename placeholder; covered by knowledge extraction, attachment-context and adapter tests.
Replacement/version chains and deletion tombstones preserve derived knowledge state and make restore/reindex behavior explicit.
Unified search fans out over conversations/messages, projects, files, knowledge blocks, artifacts, memories, saved prompts and Work sessions/events.
The command palette calls the server-side unified search route; covered by tests/unified-search.test.ts.
Each group returns bounded snippets and marked title/snippet terms; covered by tests/unified-search.test.ts.
Hits carry message, project, file, knowledge block, artifact, run-event and code destinations; exact in-document inspector navigation remains partial.
Per-source coverage reports complete/partial/unavailable and knowledge indexing degradation is surfaced rather than hidden.

Attachment versions/revisions, parser state, storage/quota accounting including deleted rows, cursor pagination, deleted-only Recently Deleted, and revision/deleted restore are wired into the Library UI and APIs.
Cross-account isolation is already proven by test on web and native. Must stay proven.

slices.title: Memory that is inspectable, scoped and correctable

acceptance.text: Manual create, edit/apply, automatic extraction and consolidation all pass the suppression gate; covered by tests/memory-suppression.test.ts.
Consolidation resolves the background-provider policy and reports a distinct denial; live provider coverage remains deployment-dependent.
Natural-language edits are reviewable and policy-aware; provider-unavailable responses are explicit.
Typed categories and lifecycle statuses are centralized in memory-categories.ts; covered by tests/memory-lifecycle.test.ts.
Normalization/dedup, contradiction/supersession and expiry are covered by tests/memory-lifecycle.test.ts.
Responses expose the memories used, source chat and a Forget control; covered by memory lifecycle/receipt tests and the chat UI.

Versioned Juno export/import preserves settings, projects/branches, message metadata, memory provenance/supersession, attachment manifests and versioned bytes with per-account archive-SHA idempotency and per-object byte digests; serializable commit, durable object cleanup/recovery, fail-closed incomplete archives and parser-lease recovery are wired, while deployed runtime proof remains release-gated.

slices.title: Durable research job with citation integrity

acceptance.text: Persisted state machine, cursor, audit rows and a fenced worker lease/backstop survive request loss; production topology is covered by tests/research-worker.test.ts and the PM2 juno-research process.
Editable plan, confirmation gate, pause/resume/cancel and steering are covered by tests/research-run.test.ts.
ResearchClaim/Passage/ClaimLink rows persist supporting and contradicting passage ids, strength and status; database-backed inspector coverage remains.

Post-synthesis audit validates and labels unsupported/partial/contradicted/unverified claims, preserves draft/final revisions, and clears the 100-claim >=95% precision benchmark in tests/research-citations.test.ts.
Fetched source snapshots, hashes, publication dates and source-policy scores are persisted; source rank and syndication events are auditable.
Third-party source URLs cannot become clickable links unless http(s). Fixed 2026-08-07 at the render chokepoint.

slices.title: Every generated file is opened and checked before it is presented

acceptance.text: The chat artifact export route re-opens DOCX/XLSX/PPTX bytes before constructing the response; covered by tests/artifact-export-verification.test.ts.

Deliverable/package validation checks bounded archive inflation, overflow, cached-formula presence, missing assets, unsafe markup, and generated design export envelopes; covered by artifact/export/design tests.
Verification reports are retained and failed exports are refused; automatic revision is not wired for chat artifacts.
XLSX validation inspects formulas/cached results, external references, chart parts, named-range references and overflow; unsupported generation is refused rather than guessed.
Sandboxed preview frames use an enforced per-iframe CSP and allow-scripts-only sandbox; covered by tests/sandbox-security.test.ts.

slices.title: Skills and plugins cannot smuggle instructions or expand permissions silently

acceptance.text: Imported skill instructions are wrapped as untrusted content and the runner uses the runtime envelope; covered by tests/work-skill-trust.test.ts.
Manifests, code, prompts, declared domains, dependencies and tool schemas are scanned on version changes with persisted evidence and a trust state.
Permission expansion invalidates prior consent and requires an explicit new consent before execution.
Skill versions declare requestedTools and the resolver only narrows the run's available set; remaining work is UI polish.
Schedules persist exact skill-version pins and refuse missing versions; covered by tests/work-skills.test.ts and trigger/schedule tests.

slices.title: No model reaches production without a human

acceptance.text: The nightly model sync pushes only its branch and opens a PR against main; covered by tests/model-sync-governance.test.ts.
Routable models have persisted capability probes with evidence and a 24-hour expiry; discovered models stay opt-in until healthy.
Web, cloud Code, native manifests and model APIs route away from expired/failed capability probes; covered by model-capability and catalog tests.

Bounded production HTTP smoke exists for health, authenticated model-contract/provider-backed chat/receipt/replay, and public HTML/security/auth-boundary routes; the workflow requires authenticated smoke, while browser automation is still outstanding.

Read-only health and public UI/auth-boundary smoke pass against chat.liams.dev on live artifact ce36248fa1e466bccf8f52fed2e589b32b2d8951; authenticated catalog/chat replay remains unrun without a dedicated smoke account.

HTTP health and fail-closed authenticated smoke hooks are wired; authenticated chat/citation/search/approval/budget/disconnect/recovery still need a configured staging credential plus browser/native execution.
Desktop/tablet/phone, light/dark, reduced motion, empty/loading/error/partial/success, long and localized strings.

Backup/verify/restore scripts and a scratch-only runbook now exist for PostgreSQL plus local/S3 objects, but a disposable database/object-storage restore drill with measured RPO/RTO has not yet been exercised.
